structured_output.what_is_happening: SI "Super Intelligence" is about 41 minutes old. The creator made the token and opened a PumpSwap pool 30 seconds later, so it did not graduate from the pump.fun curve and its address does not end in "pump". It has traded $5.3M of volume on about $133k market cap, a turnover of about 27x in one hour, and price is up about 104%. The pool holds about $198k of liquidity, more than the whole market cap, and 73% of supply. The LP is 0% burned or locked. RugCheck flags it as "danger: LP unlocked" and "few LP providers". The most striking figure is on GeckoTerminal: 2,246 unique buyers but only 55 unique sellers, and those 55 wallets made about 3,459 sells. GMGN counts 48 bundler wallets holding about 22% of top-trader activity. It finds no smart-money, KOL or sniper wallets and no paid promotion. The story is a claim that Trump renamed AI to "Super Intelligence". At least 9 other SI / Super Intelligence tokens were launched in the same hours.

narrative.description: A news-driven meme: "Trump said AI is now called Super Intelligence." A political plus AI hook like this can spread quickly while the headline is fresh. The project links only to a single X status from gum_xbt, likely a repost of the news, not a project account.
narrative.why_spreading: A fresh Trump/AI headline set off a burst of launches. Many SI tokens were created within about 5 hours, and several have more than $1M in hourly volume. That shows real speculative attention on the meta, but it is spread across many copycats.

token_connection.why_this_token: It has the most volume of the SI tokens in the packet, but it has no website or socials, and its only link is a tweet from someone else's account. Nothing makes it the official token for the headline.
token_connection.competing_tokens: 82ezh...pump (Super Intelligence) is about 4 hours older, at $578k market cap with $357k of hourly volume. It is the likely canonical pump.fun version. ESwAE... (non-pump) has $1.7M of hourly volume at $88k market cap, the same pattern as this token. 9LUf...pump sits at $546k market cap. Super Inu, also SI, is at $6.3M. There are several dead clones.

authenticity.evidence: About 3,459 sells came from only 55 unique sellers, against 2,246 unique buyers. A small set of wallets is repeatedly selling into retail buys. GMGN flags 48 bundlers holding about 22% of top-trader activity. Turnover of 27x in an hour on a pool larger than the market cap looks like volume-bot or extraction activity, not organic trading. The dev created the pool directly, with unlocked LP and few LP providers. There are no smart or KOL wallets. The linked X account was recycled (solgummies, renamed to gum_xbt).
authenticity.uncertainty: The 2,246 unique buyers could include real retail chasing the headline. The low seller count could partly be early buyers still holding. GeckoTerminal's seller counts could also be wrong.

structural_risks: The LP is 0% burned or locked in a pool the creator deployed. The creator can remove about $198k of liquidity at any moment.
Liquidity is larger than market cap and holds 73% of supply. A single LP owner makes a classic pull-the-liquidity setup.
Only 55 unique sellers against 2,246 buyers suggests insiders are selling into buy flow, or that retail sells are somehow restricted.
Many copycat SI tokens split the attention for the meta.

structured_output.counterargument: The headline is new and politically charged, and this token is the SI copy getting the most volume. It has thousands of unique buyers, a spread-out top 10 (12%), renounced authorities and no tax. If the Trump/SI story trends on X, the volume leader among the copies could run from about $135k to over $270k within hours, and the deep pool makes a 2x mechanically easy. A dev-created PumpSwap pool is not proof of a rug.

structured_output.thesis: This is one of many copies riding a hot Trump/AI headline. The structure is built for extraction: the dev made the pool, the LP is unlocked and larger than the market cap, 55 sellers against 2,246 buyers, bundlers, and wash-level turnover. The most likely outcome is that the LP is pulled or the price bleeds out within 6 hours. There is some chance of a 2x before that because the headline is hot, but it is well below break-even.
